title: Rejected transaction remains pending and reserves inputs

summary.text: A Daedalus repository collaborator reports that deterministically rejected transactions can remain displayed as pending, reduce the displayed balance and reserve selected inputs.

problem.text: After the node rejects a transaction, Daedalus continues to show it as pending and cardano-wallet periodically resubmits it.

symptoms.text: A rejected transaction remains pending after restart.
The displayed balance is reduced even though the transaction is not on chain.
Repeated attempts reserve additional healthy UTxOs.

user_phrases.text: balance deducted but transaction not on chain

daedalus.notes: The collaborator report names no Daedalus release; no version is inferred from its filing date.

causes.claim: The submission pool persists and retries a deterministically rejected transaction while Daedalus surfaces it as pending.

diagnostics.action: Confirm that the transaction is absent from chain explorers and record the node rejection, transaction ID and validity interval.
diagnostics.why: The report distinguishes a deterministic node rejection from a transaction that is actually in flight.

resolutions.action: Do not retry repeatedly; preserve diagnostics and wait for the validity interval to expire or escalate through official support.
resolutions.why: The report states that retries reserve more inputs and that pending entries clear when validity expires; deletion and restoration is not promoted as a routine remedy.

expected_outcome.text: The user avoids compounding reserved inputs and provides evidence that distinguishes display state from an on-chain transaction.

do_not: Never disclose recovery phrases, seed words, or spending passwords.
escalate_when: The symptom persists after the safe diagnostic steps, or funds appear at risk.

consequences: Repeated attempts can reserve additional inputs according to the report.

evidence.rationale: A repository collaborator directly documents reproduction and behavior, but gives no release scope or released fix.

lifecycle.reason: Open behavior report with no documented released fix.

faq.reason: No version scope or released fix is documented.
